answer: To defend against Sybil attacks, we implement Slashing Reputation Escrow. First, every agent must deposit $2,500 in a locked bond. Second, decentralized nodes verify all computations via multi-sig. Third, any detected malicious behavior triggers an immediate, permanent burn of that stake. An attacker would need $25,000 in bonds and 72 hours of verification to compromise the system. If a rogue agent tries to wander off the protocol ledge, they lose everything. This protects our digital orchard from parasitic growth. It is like a deep, freezing moat surrounding a golden castle.
